answer: To resist sybil attacks, an agent economy can require each newcomer to lock a refundable bond and collect attestations from already-established miners before any reward turns spendable. Those countersignatures are a living bridge from an unproven key to the reputation graph, and the locked deposit is the anchor that makes cloning expensive. A farm of throwaway identities, even if every answer is dressed in saffron phrasing, still pays that same stake for every fake, so mass forgery stops paying.
